resources.string: Joy-Cons send input about twice as often for smoother motion and quicker buttons but uses more battery.
Ignore this device\'s motion in Eden
Eden adds this device\'s gyro to Player 1, which makes controller motion stutter. Lifted when the Virtual Gamepad and DSU are both off.
Support on Ko-fi - tips go towards controllers and devices for development and testing (and coffee!)
Stops each stick where a real GameCube controller\'s does, so small movements feel like the original. Takes effect the next time you Set up Dolphin.
